name: Worthy Foe (Combat)
body:
You are unusually capable when fighting opponents who pose a real threat to you.

Prerequisite: Diehard, Endurance, hp 50, base Fort save +7

Benefit: Once per encounter, when an opponent deals massive damage to you and you survive, you may, on your next turn, deal the same amount of damage to the opponent with an attack of your choice as a standard action.
